title: Matter / Chrome D

subjects.identity: One continuous liquid-chrome pebble or droplet with a polished mirror surface; the same volume becomes a sculptural capital D with one open central cavity.

style: Premium cobalt studio product photography, restrained, tactile and physically coherent.
motion_intent: The single chrome droplet coherently reshapes into a dimensional capital D while conserving its material and apparent mass. The D is a physical sculpture, never overlaid typography.
scene: Locked three-quarter camera in a saturated cobalt studio; center-right studio floor and soft grounded shadow; left 35 percent stays quiet for editable HTML copy.
continuity: Same single subject, chrome material, cobalt environment, camera, lighting, studio floor and contact shadow throughout.
No detached fragments, extra droplets, added letters, baked text, interface, logos or camera cuts.
The final D has a clear negative-space cavity and remains recognizable as a three-dimensional object from the locked view.
Motion is reversible by seeking backward in the same clip.

destination.site_role: Scroll-controlled hero in a complete personal website; editable headline and navigation are DOM overlays.
destination.mobile: Contain the full 16:9 image without cropping; retain DOM text outside the media as needed.
destination.scroll_container: 300svh section with a 100svh sticky stage, giving two viewport heights of travel.
